label: Microring-assisted lateral SACM Ge APD, R 7 um Si ring, 300-mm SOI
core_material: Si ring waveguide 350 nm wide on 300-mm SOI; selective epitaxial Ge in a 180 nm x 400 nm trench inside the ring; p- Si layer forms a lateral SACM structure
notes: All fabrication on the Samsung Foundry 300-mm SiPh platform (p.~1 Sec. 2). Ring radius 7 um and ring FSR ~9 nm (p.~1) entered as radius_um / fsr_nm (m8, m9; D81 allowances). Avalanche gain 7.5 at -6.1 V (unity gain defined at -2.0 V, Fig. 3(c)) and GBP 165 GHz at -6.1 V / 253 GHz at -6.5 V (Fig. 4(c)) entered (m5-m7, D81). Not entered (no registry parameter): on-resonance photocurrent 30x off-resonance; author crosstalk estimate ~10 dB. Dark current and gain uniformity shown only as wafer histograms (Fig. 3(d)-(e), no values in text). Ge footprint 'sub-um2'. An MMI tap before the device gives a reference output.

label: 4-core-fiber fan-in/fan-out, fs-laser-written 3D glass waveguides (1x4 FA 127 um to 2x2 4CF 40 um)
core_material: fs-laser direct-written single-scan waveguides in borosilicate glass, quasi-circular, diameter ~18-20 um, max index difference 0.005; four S-curved paths
notes: Packaged by UV-glue bonding of the FA and 4CF. Written with the authors' self-developed fs-laser direct-writing equipment (515 nm, 1 MHz, SLM beam shaping, 40x NA 0.65 objective), single scan up to 30 mm/s. Authors at Shenzhen University and Shenzhen Photonics Valley Technology Co., Ltd; fabricating org not unambiguous, fab_org_ids empty. Inter-core crosstalk < -46.4 dB entered as crosstalk_db (m10, D81). Not entered: packaging-added loss ~0.1 dB (equals post- minus pre-packaging mean); high-order-mode added loss 0.03 dB (0.07 %) from a 10 km vs 1 m fiber comparison (no parameter); mode field said to match SMF (no MFD value). 15 devices on one bar (60 waveguides) tested.

label: fs-laser-written single-scan waveguide in borosilicate glass (FI/FO waveguide)
core_material: fs-laser-modified quasi-circular core in borosilicate glass, max index difference 0.005
notes: Waveguide of the FI/FO chip (row cmp_ofc2026_th1d4_fifo_4cf); same fabrication notes.

label: Two-section directly modulated DFB laser for FMCW LiDAR, 2 x 300 um
notes: Two 300-um sections electrically isolated by etching the ternary contact layer; asymmetric injection (section I modulated, section II 200 mA). Material system and lasing wavelength not stated. Not entered (no registry parameter): FM response at 200 kHz, Ipp 2 mA (Table 1): excursion 2.9 GHz, nonlinearity 0.65 % up-ramp / 0.28 % down-ramp (80 % ROI); FM efficiency 1.45 GHz/mA entered as fm_efficiency_ghz_per_ma (m4, D81). LiDAR accuracy 0.05 m / 0.7 km/h is a system result. Fabricating org not stated (authors at 3SP Technologies, Telecom Paris, Universite Laval).

label: Single-section DFB reference, 600 um, structure identical to the two-section laser
notes: Comparison device. FM efficiency 0.07 GHz/mA (Table 1) entered as fm_efficiency_ghz_per_ma (m3, D81). Table 1, no registry parameters: Ipp 40 mA, excursion 2.9 GHz, nonlinearity 4.10 % up / 4.76 % down. Material and wavelength not stated.

label: O-band QD etched-facet U-turn FP laser, micro-transfer-printed and butt-coupled to SiN on Si
core_material: GaAs-based coupon: eight QD layers (QD material not stated), GaAs/AlGaAs dilute waveguide (1000 nm total), AlGaAs claddings, p-GaAs contact; Bezier U-turn puts both facets on one side
notes: Coupons released from the native GaAs substrate and printed into etched recesses of a SiN-on-Si chip (150 nm LPCVD SiN on 5 um thermal SiO2, PECVD SiO2 cladding); recess Si RMS roughness 0.4 nm (AFM). Facet dielectric stack intended for ~30 % reflectivity. Simulated, not entered: dilute waveguide doubles modal area, >3 dB higher coupling at 0.5 um vertical misalignment, ~0.6 cm for 20 dB gain. LI at 20-70 C and spectra at 200-600 mA shown without numbers. Authors at UCSB and Tyndall; fabricating org not stated, fab_org_ids empty. 'A portion of this work was performed in the UCSB Nanofabrication Facility' (p.~3 Acknowledgements) -> facility_org_ids (registry addition 2026-10-20).

label: Butt coupling, MTP QD-laser etched facet to SiN waveguide facet in an etched recess
core_material: SiN 150 nm (LPCVD) waveguide facet formed by the recess etch; QD coupon with GaAs/AlGaAs dilute waveguide
notes: Per-facet value for the two facets of one U-turn laser coupon (row cmp_ofc2026_w2a15_qd_fp_uturn_mtp).

label: Bezier-curve U-turn waveguide in the QD laser coupon (simulated)
notes: U-turn fabricated in the printed QD lasers (p.~2 Sec. 3, Fig. 3); only a simulated loss is reported (D80e, row_kind fabricated). The U-turn concept is from the authors' earlier work [7].

label: Monolithic dual-mode DFB laser (10 deg tilted dicing at the grating end face), ~300 GHz spacing, TO-can
core_material: 5-pair InAlGaAs MQW with upper / lower SCH on n-InP (MOCVD); 240 nm grating with lambda/4 phase shift on the upper SCH
notes: Chip 400 um wide x 1200 um long; end face near the grating diced at 10 deg to open two DBR transmission windows. Pigtailed TO-can; temperature set by a home-made cooler. Grating period 240 nm entered as period_nm (m18, D81). P-I slope 37 -> 34.42 (21 -> 25 C) not entered in slope_efficiency_w_per_a: unit printed 'mA/W', so the value cannot be placed in W/A without reinterpretation. Not entered (no registry parameter): power-temperature slope 7.75e-2 mW/C, resistance 27.08 ohm, two-mode peak difference 20.5 -> 9.8 dB (12 -> 108 mA); sub-THz carrier -38 dBm, CNR 37 dB (UTC-PD system result). Text cites Fig. 1(b)/1(c) for spectra and wavelengths; captions show Fig. 2(b)/2(c). Relaxation oscillation 1.85 / 12 GHz at 12 / 60 mA entered (m19, m20, D81). Fabricating org not stated (authors at NICT and National Taiwan University).

label: Curved tunable directional coupler (two laterally offset heaters), Si, imec MPW
core_material: Si waveguides (thickness not stated); two bent equal-width waveguides with slightly different radii, metal heaters offset laterally
notes: 'fabricated via IMEC's multi-project wafer (MPW) process' (p.~2 Sec. 2). Gap, width, radii and heater offset optimized by PSO and thermal simulation (values not stated). TE, C band. Used in pairs in the central-stage cells of the 4x4 DLN switch (rows cmp_ofc2026_m2d2_ulx_mzi_cell, cmp_ofc2026_m2d2_dln_4x4).

label: Ultralow-crosstalk 2x2 MZI switch cell (two CTDCs, 180-um heaters on both arms)
notes: Central-stage cell of the 4x4 DLN fabric; biases found by an iterative CTDC / phase-shifter algorithm (2-3 iterations per cell). Values for a representative cell.

label: 4x4 DLN thermo-optic Si MZI switch fabric, 12 cells, CTDC cells in the center stage
notes: Outer-stage cells use passive MMIs. Chip 3.5 x 1.4 mm2, wire-bonded to PCBs, on a Cu heat sink with TEC. Per-path power consumption shown only in Fig. 2(c).

label: Vertical fiber-array coupling to the switch chip (coupler type not named)
notes: 'angled fiber array couples light into and out of the chip in a vertical configuration' (p.~2 Sec. 2); coupler type not named, class grating inferred from the vertical configuration.

label: S/C/L-band 3:1 MUX, BDBS-designed mosaic digital metamaterial, 3.6 x 12 um2
core_material: Si 220 nm; mosaic of 24 x 80 square pixels (150 nm), '0' pixels are 120 nm diameter SiO2-filled holes; 30 nm margin; inputs 0.6 um, output 0.8 um wide
notes: EBL and dry etching; GC I/O; TE measured with tunable lasers; straight-waveguide transmission on the same chip subtracted. Optimized at 1470/1490/1510 (S), 1530/1550/1570 (C) and 1590/1610/1630 (L) nm. Measured DMUX spectra limited to >1495 nm by the GCs. 'We fabricated the designed device' (p.~2 Sec. 2), but the authors span Hosei University, Sumitomo Electric Industries and PETRA, so the fabricating org is not unambiguous (fab_org_ids empty, D72). ARIM (MEXT) support acknowledged under a grant (p.~3 Acknowledgement); ARIM is in the registry (org_advanced_research_infrastructure_for_materials_and_nanotechnology_in_japan), not a facility_org_id: program / grant acknowledgement (D80c, also M4D.3, tanaka2026). Class wdm.other (D81 subtype); the 3 band ports (S, C, L) are in n_channels (m5).

label: Gap-filled S/C/L-band MUX (mosaic redesign, 81 pixels changed)
core_material: Si 220 nm; mosaic of 24 x 80 square pixels (150 nm), '0' pixels are 120 nm diameter SiO2-filled holes; 30 nm margin; inputs 0.6 um, output 0.8 um wide
notes: Redesigned from the first pattern (row cmp_ofc2026_tu2j4_scl_mux_mosaic) with 1-nm-spaced band-edge wavelengths (S 1525-1529, C 1530-1534 and 1566-1570, L 1571-1575 nm), alpha 0.3. Fabricated (SEM, Fig. 3); measured DMUX spectra said to agree with the calculation, no measured number stated. Class wdm.other as for the first design (D81).

label: Dual-mode (TE0-LP01 / TE1-LP11) blazed subwavelength GC with SWG AR section, 220 nm SOI, to FMF
core_material: Si 220 nm on 2 um BOX; doubly etched blazed grating (220 nm full and 70 nm partial etch) with subwavelength segments; SWG anti-reflection section
notes: 'designed and fabricated ... using foundry process' (p.~2 Sec. 3); foundry not named. TE0 / TE1 multiplexed on chip by asymmetric directional couplers (no metrics). LP01 from SMF in, FMF out. Fabricated peak ~10 nm blue-shifted; coupling angle reduced by 1 deg to keep the peak near 1550 nm (absolute angle not stated). Not entered: simulated directionality >78.56 %, simulated CE*BW 34.1 / 32.7.

label: 850-nm cryogenic VCSEL, 7-um aperture
notes: Material system not stated. Cryogenic chamber, GSG probe, power by a calibrated large-area PD. Slope efficiency 1.18 W/A at I/Ith ~150 at 3 K entered as slope_efficiency_w_per_a (D77). The 5-um-aperture device used for spectra (RMS width <0.6 nm at 2-20 mA, 3 K; Sec. 1 / Sec. 4 say <0.58 nm) and PAM-4 links (140 Gb/s at 20 K; 128 Gb/s at 3 / 40 K, TDECQ 2.67 / 3.1 dB) has no registry-parameter value and is not a row. Fabricating org not stated (authors at National Taiwan University and UIUC).

label: Twin EO-tunable RTF laser (two QCSE RTFs sharing one active section via a 1x2 MZI switch), InP monolithic
core_material: InP monolithic; gain MQW (active section) and QCSE MQW (RTFs, MZI switch) by butt-joint regrowth; each RTF a 1x5 MMI with five reflection-type delay lines
notes: Athermal fixed-wavelength operation over 20-70 C chip temperature with SLC switching (~25 switchings), ACT current 50 mA. Not entered (no registry parameter): frequency error within +/-2.5 GHz (Fig. 4(b), 5), MZI-switch switching time 100 ns, phase-tuning LM interval ~0.2 nm; 64-Gbaud DP-QPSK BER <1e-7 is a system result. 'We developed' the laser (pNA Abstract; p.~3 Conclusion) and all authors are at NTT Device Innovation Center, but there is no fabrication statement, so fab_org_ids is empty (D80b).
